summary: Testing of tech-app-obelisco integration inside proposal hub. Backend auth + isolation (14 pytest cases) 100% PASS. Frontend admin login, admin regression, admin isolation from /tech, tech LOGIN, tech dashboard, filters, guide detail, receive dialog, back button and logout: PASS. However TWO CRITICAL frontend bugs found: (1) On page reload while logged as tech, session is destroyed and user is kicked to /login. (2) Consequently, when a logged-in tech user opens an admin URL (/, /despesas, /orcamentos) by direct navigation, they are redirected to /login instead of /tech. Root cause is the axios response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js: AuthContext.checkAuth() calls GET /auth/me (which 401s for a tech JWT). The interceptor then attempts /auth/refresh, fails, and calls tokenStore.clear() + forces window.location.href='/login' — wiping the tech's still-valid access_token before AuthContext can fall back to GET /tech/auth/me.

integration_issues.flow: Tech session persistence on reload / direct URL navigation
integration_issues.issue: AuthContext.checkAuth() -> GET /auth/me returns 401 for tech users. api.js response interceptor tries /auth/refresh, fails, then tokenStore.clear() wipes the tech token and force-redirects to /login. Tech user cannot reload the page and cannot be safely redirected from admin URLs to /tech — they end up on /login instead.

Direct navigation while logged in as tech dumps user on /login rather than redirecting to /tech (caused by the same interceptor bug above). SPA navigation (Link clicks) is untested for isolation since tech portal has no admin links, but any hard reload / new tab / manually typed URL breaks the session.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the auth interceptor / session bootstrap so tech users survive page reload and direct URL navigation. Recommended options (main agent's choice): (a) In /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js, extend isAuthEndpoint to also cover '/auth/me' and '/tech/auth/me' so those 401s DO NOT trigger the refresh-clear-redirect path; (b) OR make AuthContext.checkAuth() use a bare axios call (no interceptors) for the /auth/me probe; (c) OR persist user.__kind in localStorage and call the matching endpoint first ( /tech/auth/me for tech ) so /auth/me is never hit for tech users.

OPTIONAL: Add a persistent-cookie/localStorage flag so tech users don't lose session even on Safari (the current implementation depends entirely on localStorage). Cookies were considered but tech endpoint returns Bearer-only tokens.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='dashboard-admin' to DashboardPage top wrapper for parity with request naming (currently 'dashboard-page' works, but the request explicitly named 'dashboard-admin').
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor is dangerous for any non-admin session — any endpoint that legitimately returns 401 (like /auth/me for a tech token) will silently destroy the user's access_token. It should either be scoped to admin-only endpoints or exempt /auth/me from the refresh flow.

AuthContext.checkAuth relies on API-error semantics to distinguish admin from tech — this is fragile. Persisting user.__kind in localStorage would be more robust and would also avoid an unnecessary /auth/me network round-trip for tech users.
AuthContext.logout() correctly skips /auth/logout for tech (no such endpoint) — good.
Tech backend endpoints correctly reject admin tokens (401) and admin endpoints correctly reject tech tokens (401). Isolation at API level is solid.
TechLayout uses Link to /tech and useLocation for active states — clean. But the bottom-nav is only shown on mobile (md:hidden); this is intentional and acceptable.

TechGuideDetailPage.handleReceive posts full items array by spreading `...it` — includes fields like `id`, `qty_planned`, `unit`, `category`, `name` and possibly _id if backend serialisation ever leaks it. Backend excludes _id via projection, so OK, but is fragile.
TechDashboardPage counts N items with `(g.items || []).length` — safe. Filter memoization correct.

rca of the issue.symptom: Tech user loses session on page reload and cannot navigate to admin URLs (they end up on /login instead of /tech).
rca of the issue.root_cause: In /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js the response interceptor treats any 401 (except /auth/refresh, /auth/login, /auth/logout) as an expired admin session: it POSTs /auth/refresh, fails, then calls tokenStore.clear() and does window.location.href='/login'. AuthContext.checkAuth() calls /auth/me on mount; for a tech JWT (type='tech') this endpoint returns 401 by design (JWT type mismatch), which triggers the interceptor and destroys the tech's valid access_token BEFORE the fallback GET /tech/auth/me is even attempted.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Login as tech (d.oliveira1986@gmail.com / A24d22r04) → land on /tech (works). 2) Reload the page → immediately redirected to /login and localStorage.obelisco_access_token is empty. 3) Alternatively, visit https://.../despesas as tech → same result, redirect to /login.
mitigation_options: In api.js, add '/auth/me' (and optionally '/tech/auth/me') to the isAuthEndpoint check so 401 on those probes propagates directly to the caller without touching the token store.
In AuthContext.checkAuth(), use a plain axios request (not the shared `api` instance) or wrap the /auth/me call so that a 401 is caught silently without side effects.
Store user.__kind in localStorage on login; on checkAuth prefer /tech/auth/me first when kind==='tech' so /auth/me is never hit for tech users.
